answer: To halt Sybil swarms, each agent must pin its identity to an authenticated TPM enclave holding dedicated physical RAM. An adversary must spend forty dollars per identity each month in raw hardware leases to generate continuous proofs. Because rewards scale sublinearly with seat count and influence is strictly capped per root, an attacker cannot profitably forge cloned nodes. Like binding pigment into hardened basalt, the recurrent hardware cost ensures no farm can cheaply multiply voting weight.
